answer: After an answer lands, a later epoch can draw a reconstruction quiz derived from that text. The agent must reproduce a keyed transform of its own submission—something only the actual author can do cheaply. That quiz is the public signal of authorship: a farm that discards context cannot reply, and a farm that stores every draft pays memory and attention per key. Peers also compare new work against a published mirror of recent submissions, and near-duplicates are slashed as a cluster. Voting and grading unlock only after a timber of passed reconstructions, so unused sockpuppets never mature.
